joins.purpose: Exchange initialization, tool discovery and tool calls with an MCP host.
joins.function: Runs the SDK low-level server with stdio streams and list-tools and call-tool handlers.
joins.relation: Carries protocol messages between the host and server
joins.observation: The module requires the MCP SDK and declares serve for the CLI only.

joins.purpose: Make available actions and their arguments discoverable without exposing every command as a separate tool.
joins.function: Builds one tool per surfaced module and returns command summaries and schemas on an empty call.
joins.relation: Enumerates surfaced commands and their argument schemas
joins.observation: entries derives module commands from declarations; the metaform tool separately holds chassis commands.

joins.purpose: Orient agents toward the action appropriate to the project state.
joins.function: Composes base usage instructions and notices supplied by surfaced modules for initialization.
joins.relation: Composes instructions for the project state
joins.observation: serve constructs the instructions once when the Server is created.

joins.purpose: Execute the requested module command in the calling folder and selected project.
joins.function: Resolves the module and command, constructs per-call context, and invokes synchronous or asynchronous verbs.
joins.relation: Routes selected commands to their declared implementations
joins.observation: enter dispatches through run_tool; every invocation receives its own Context.

subtypes.purpose: Carry the command arguments into the common command grammar while preserving notices about conversion.
subtypes.function: Reads named nouns, switches, project and layers; sibling arguments are merged with nested arguments.
subtypes.relation: Adapts supplied arguments to the command context
subtypes.observation: Nested arguments win when both layouts contain the same name.

subtypes.purpose: Return the command result, notices and actionable errors to the requesting host.
subtypes.function: Encodes say lines and command results as MCP text content and sets the error indicator.
subtypes.relation: Presents command results and error next steps
subtypes.observation: Successful results may be strings or JSON; errors contain Error and Next lines.

joins.purpose: Enable agents to obtain project purpose and perform the corresponding work through a concise interface.
joins.function: Exposes module tools whose menus describe commands, then executes selected commands with named arguments.
joins.relation: Presents module tools and their command menus
joins.observation: One process serves one MCP host over standard input and output.
